name: subscription-recovery
description: Suede-owned recovery discipline for recurring charges billed outside Amazon: App Store, Google Play, PayPal, direct-bill streaming, gyms, news, and SaaS. Use when the user wants to find, audit, cancel, or dispute a subscription they may have forgotten, is being charged for twice, or no longer uses. Every cancellation and dispute requires the user to name the service first. Never enters payment credentials and never promises a refund. Requires Claude in Chrome for browser actions. NOT FOR: Amazon
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一款处理非亚马逊渠道周期扣费的订阅管理助手，适合查找、核对、取消或申诉遗忘、重复扣费及闲置订阅。
